what: The speed numbers on the card, rounded as the card shows them, copied from packaging/measurements.json (the full file names the operator's namespace in its bundle field, which the package scrub refuses, so it is not shipped).
bundle: the installed v6 bundle qwen3.8-27b-dflash2-p300 (2 chips, bfp8 weights, DFlash2 drafter on, sampling on the device)
decoding: greedy (temperature 0), thinking mode as the chat template defaults it, streamed

method.statistics: median with min and max over the repetitions
method.ttft_s: seconds from sending the request to the first content, reasoning or tool-call chunk
method.decode_tok_s: (completion tokens - 1) / seconds from the first chunk to the last, per run

not_measured_or_not_comparable: the two models write different text for the same prompt on some prompts (see same_generated_text and the token counts), and with a speculative drafter the decode rate depends on the text and on how often the drafter's guesses are accepted. A difference of the size seen here (a few percent to 15%, in both directions) is within what that alone could explain; this file supports no claim that the fine-tune is faster or slower than the base.
server_ready_s is not comparable: the pi server started on a warm tensor cache and the base server on an empty one.

one board, one session, three repetitions per prompt, greedy decoding only; no concurrency (max_num_seqs 4 was configured; one request at a time was sent), no long-context prefill, no sampling with a temperature.
output quality was not measured here. The author's own benchmark claims (Pi-harness completion by reasoning effort) are charts on the model card; they were not read and are not verified.
the tool-call prompt produced 55 tokens for both models (a short call); it is in the set to show tool calling works, and the 100-token floor is met by the other three prompts.
drafter_acceptance: not measured: the server exports no spec-decode counters on /metrics and prints none in its log. Decode tokens per second is the only net effect of the drafter that was measured.
